script.heading: ca03 trailer script (Help desk resets)
script.brief: See docs/video/scripts/ca03_trailer_script.md and docs/video/takes_ca03.md (recorded 23 Nov, commit 71fb068b1). Model ca07 and ca04 (attack-first). Marks and frame-time windows from the recorded takes; Sulafat VO; PeaceFolk Gently Decaying window from 104.478 s. Hook is Niamh H1 sentence 1, end line is Anjali E1 sentence 1 (Darren muted in the take); no cast line is under VO. Leila is unvoiced (owner question L1).

alternatives: PeaceFolk/Gently Decaying.mp3 @60.862 (quiet bar under the flip and blue card, lift at the queue; overlaps the ca15 window)
